# GitHub Copilot entry point

Follow the shared repository instructions in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Copilot may also discover
the thin `CLAUDE.md` entry point; neither file adds policy beyond the shared governance documents.
Copilot-native skills and GitHub automation live in `.github/`. See
[Agentic Design](../docs/governance/agentic-design.md) for the skill boundary and
[working with coding agents](../docs/guides/coding-agents.md) for discovery checks.
